text.en:
MALACAÑAN PALACE
BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES
[ EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 262, September 24, 1970 ]
ADJUSTING THE QUARTERS ALLOWANCES OF COMMISSIONED OFFICERS OF THE ARMED
FORCES OF THE PHILIPPINES
Pursuant to the authority vested in me by Section 90 of the National Defense Act as amended, in conjunction
with Executive Order No. 4, S-46, as amended by Executive Order No. 10, S-46, I, FERDINAND E.
MARCOS, President of the Philippines, do hereby prescribe the following rates of monthly quarters
allowances for commissioned officers of the Armed Forces of the Philippines, effective this date:
Second Lieutenant (or Ensign)
First Lieutenant (or Lieutenant Junior Grade)
Captain (or Lieutenant Senior Grade)
Major (or Lieutenant Commander)
Lieutenant Colonel (or Commander)
Colonel (or Captain, Philippine Navy)
Brigadier General (or Commodore)
Major General (or Rear Admiral
General (Chief of Staff of the Armed Forces
The Secretary of National Defense shall promulgate rules and regulations to carry out the provisions hereof.
Done in the City of Manila, this 24th day of September, in the year of our Lord, nineteen hundred and seventy
and of the Independence of the Philippines, the twenty fourth.
(SGD.) FERDINAND E. MARCOS
President of the Philippines
By the President:
(SGD.) ALEJANDRO MELCHOR
Executive Secretary
